known_outcome: Council answers (leakage, summary): portables not separated by the minimum IBC separation are aggregated into clusters (Q1, Q2 yes); the space between portables is not counted (Q3); separated portables are not counted in the aggregate (Q4 no); under the 2012 amendment portables with occupant load over 50 are sprinklered (Q5 yes); Exception 2 does not apply to portable buildings (Q6 no); connected portables may be split by fire barriers under IFC 901.4.3, but the resulting cluster still counts toward the 5,000 sf limit (Q7).
review_focus: use of fire barriers to reduce occupant load
